about: The 14 Microduck emotions: one keyframes timeline + one robot sound each. Field meanings in README.md.
emotion_mode: Robot build only: tap D-pad Up to enter emotion mode. A short press is under 0.6 s; a long press fires once held 0.6 s.

emotions.name: sad
emotions.description: Standing, the head droops while a low coo glides down with it, two slow silent head shakes, then back up.
emotions.robot_note: Half depth on purpose: a deeper droop moves the head's mass forward and the real duck steps forward to stay up.

emotions.name: devastated
emotions.description: Sits down at once with an alarmed call, the head droops and shakes three times on three sobs, then comes back level. It stays seated.
emotions.robot_note: This keyframe file starts 0.3 s before the press: the sit and the wav start at t = 0.3 s. The robot build drops that lead-in. Stand it up again with the sit toggle (D-pad Down).

emotions.name: curious
emotions.description: 'What? what?': the head comes forward and tilts one way, then the other, on two rising chirps.
emotions.robot_note: The robot build keeps only the two tilts (head_roll). The head-forward part (neck -0.8, head_pitch -0.35) made the real duck step forward, so set neck and head_pitch to 0 on a real Microduck.

emotions.name: mmh
emotions.description: 'What do you mean?': a small head tilt held for a second with a muffled rising 'mmh?'.

emotions.name: yes
emotions.description: One clear nod with one quack that falls three semitones.

emotions.name: yes_fast
emotions.description: The same nod with a curt 'wak'.

emotions.name: no
emotions.description: One head shake with a two-note 'no-ah'. Three voicings: pick one at random.

emotions.name: defiant
emotions.description: 'Says who?': beak up to its left with a curt quack, then up to its right with a second one.

emotions.name: angry
emotions.description: Beak-up glare, then four head snaps with a hard bark on each and a small body pulse. Two voicings.
emotions.robot_note: The beak opens wide on the first bark (mouth 1.0 from 0.3 to 0.7 s) so a leash held in the beak drops.

emotions.name: mock
emotions.description: 'Gnagnagnagna': beak up, the head rolling side to side on a staccato mocking run.

emotions.name: excited
emotions.description: Six faster and faster head swings with a body bob on each, and a run of quacks climbing in pitch.

emotions.name: impatient
emotions.description: 'Come on!': four quick head shakes with a body bob each, then the beak flicks up on a huff.

emotions.name: laugh
emotions.description: Beak up, the head wagging with a body dip on every 'ha': one long 'haaa', then seven short ones dying out.

emotions.name: play_dead
emotions.description: Alarm call while the head whips to the side and the duck sits, then it goes limp, rolls onto its back and lifts its legs, with a dying quack. Needs a mat.
emotions.robot_note: The keyframes carry the sit, the head and the beak. The dead pose itself is two timed joint poses, given in pose_joints. The robot holds that pose until Start. The simulation video used 1.4 s and 3.6 s; the robot uses 1.8 s and 4.0 s, because straight legs on a duck that has not finished sitting topple it forward.

pose_joints.note: Absolute joint angles in radians (not deltas). Joints in torque_off hang free; the joints listed in targets ramp linearly from where they are over ramp_s at servo P gain `gain` (160 = the standing value) and hold; the others hold. The balance policy is off from the first stage on.

stages.what: legs straight: the seated duck rolls flat onto its back
